decision: Negative benefit gate after reviewing primary success, ceiling-case continuous metrics and mechanisms; no benefit-dependent stage3 batch required.
ceiling_review: Horizontal taper all methods 10/10; D not consistently faster or better at holding than tuned B and global C. D/C burden proxy is higher. Shorter D/B task time also has a shorter endpoint displacement.
mechanism_review: Local alpha variation and altered signed wrap distribution are present, but do not establish improved support or an advantage over both B and C.
hold_protocol: Last joint target held without further compliance or pitch updates; identical protocol across methods.
pressure_case_reason: Not all scene/method groups are at 10/10. Prior R125/140 scans were offline only. No consistent ceiling-case D benefit warrants searching larger-radius contact cases in this frozen batch.

hypotheses.H2: unsupported for this candidate; small-pipe D worse than B
hypotheses.H4: feedback candidate shows no benefit; estimation and policy contributions remain unseparated
